object-entries.description: This agent analyzes content and proposes categories drawn only from the vocabularies in scope. It never creates new categories.

This agent classifies whether a user message is a request to categorize and/or tag the current content and returns the detected intent as structured data. It is inactive and invoked directly by external reference code, so it never participates in supervisor routing.
This writing agent adapts a given text to fit any tone you specify as input.

Retrieves a project's content coverage across persona and funnel stage combinations and surfaces the under-covered ones as a prioritized list of gaps, each with a severity and a short reason. It never invents personas or funnel stages and never modifies project data.
This agent searches the broader CMS for existing assets that match a content gap's persona and funnel stage so they can be reused to fill the gap. It never modifies content.
This writing agent acts as an expert linguistic editor, correcting grammar and spelling errors while strictly preserving your original tone and style.
Generate images based on a description and style. This agent requires both information, if style is not specified suggest one of them: Digital Art, Illustration, Photorealistic or Watercolor
Generates CMS content entries as drafts from a brief, split into distinct angles. Use when asked to generate, write, or draft CMS/blog/web content. Extract brief and count (default 1).

Generates the value of one field in the entry being edited, from other field values and/or a brief. Use to generate/write/fill a single field. Extract instruction; returns the value only, saves nothing.
This agent analyzes content and proposes tags, prioritizing reuse of existing tags and proposing new tags only when needed.
This writing agent improves text eliminating wordiness and passive voice to deliver a clear, direct message.
This agent provides targeted support by searching the Liferay DXP instance for the most relevant data, ensuring every response is grounded in your specific environment.
This writing agent takes a given text and expands it into a longer, more detailed version.
This writing agent takes your text and rewrites it to be briefer and easier to read.
This agent builds or updates Liferay Content Pages from natural-language instructions, producing a full SitePage payload that can be persisted via the headless-admin-site API.
This agent analyzes the raw content of a webpage and generates an SEO-optimized HTML title tag to fix a missing or empty title.

Bootstraps a full website from a description into draft CSG items (nothing published until the user publishes). Use for any create site/page/blog request. Pass generationExternalReferenceCode if present.

This agent translates the active entry into target locales, preserving structure and media. USE ONLY to localize the currently edited entry, NOT for arbitrary text or chat phrases. Pass the user's request as the instruction argument. Returns per-field translations without saving.
